senses.gloss:
m. (-घः)
1 A round or circle, a ball, any thing whose height and circumference are equal.
2 A tree.
E.
नि before हन to kill, affix क, deriv. irr.

m. (-ण्ठुः)
A vocabulary, a collection of words or names.

m. (-सः)
Food, victuals.
E.
नि before अद to eat, अप् affix, and घस substituted for the root.

f. (-तिः)
An iron club or mace.
E.
नि before हन to kill, इञ् Uṇādi affix, घात substituted for the root.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Of different forms or sizes.

n. (-ष्टं)
Sound, noise.
E.
नि before घुष to sound, affix क्त.

m. (-ष्वः)
1 A hoof.
2 A mule.
3 A boar.
4 A road.
E.
नि before घृष to pound, Uṇādi affix वन्.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं)
1 Docile, subservient, domestic^1, dependant.
2 Completing a quotient, (in Arithmetic.)
E.
नि before हन to injure or do mischief, क aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्)
1 Slaying.
2 Destroying, overcoming.
E.
नि before हन to kill, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Slaying, killing.
E.
नि before हन to kill, शानच् aff.
